title: Sour Apple Ice Geek Bar Pulse Vape
description:
Sour Apple Ice Geek Bar Pulse Vape
Introducing the groundbreaking Sour Apple Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape—a seamless fusion of comfort and indulgence. With its astounding 15000 puffs, two power levels, and a smooth draw-activated operation, this disposable vape pen comes with 5% nicotine strength and a 16mL prefilled capacity.
Enjoyable Vaping Experience
A pleasurable vaping experience is guaranteed from the first to the last puff thanks to the union of tart green apples and a trace of menthol. This painstakingly made vape will enhance your pleasure and senses; it’s the perfect choice for those looking for a high-performing, portable option.
Profile of Sour Apple Ice Flavor
The taste profile of Sour Apple Ice Geek Bar Pulse is a mouthwatering combination of tart and energizing elements found in crisp green apples, combined with a cool touch of menthol. Experience the perfect harmony of sweetness and sourness with every draw, enhanced with a refreshing ice undertone that leaves your tongue feeling energized.
A unique combination of natural fruitiness and cooling mintiness, this taste profile is carefully developed to give a pleasant and palate-pleasing vaping experience that will captivate fans.
Features
15000 Puffs
7500 Puffs in Pulse Mode
Rechargeable
LED Battery Indicator
LED Liquid Indicator
Adjustable Power
FAQ
What is the flavor profile of the Sour Apple Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
It features a tart green apple taste combined with a refreshing menthol kick, providing a balanced sweet and sour experience.
What makes the Sour Apple Ice flavor unique?
The flavor combines the tartness of green apples with a cool menthol undertone, creating a refreshing and invigorating vaping experience.
How does the pulse mode work on the Geek Bar Pulse Sour Apple Ice?
Pulse mode increases output and airflow to 20W, delivering denser vapor and a more intense flavor profile.
Is the Geek Bar Pulse Sour Apple Ice suitable for travel?
Yes, its compact design and long-lasting battery make it ideal for on-the-go vaping.
